name: fund-ai-assistant
description: Fund portfolio tracker with AI analysis, multi-agent debate, technical indicators (VaR/Sortino/Calmar), macro monitoring, and rebalancing alerts. Data: East Money. Supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM.

primary_credential.description: LLM API key is required. Fund data comes from East Money (no auth). Push endpoints are optional and user-configured.

LLM_MODEL.description: LLM model name, e.g. gpt-4o-mini. Any OpenAI-compatible API endpoint.

LLM_API_KEY.description: API key for the LLM provider. Treat as a secret.

LLM_API_BASE.description: Custom API base URL — if set to an untrusted host, your LLM_API_KEY and fund data will be sent there. Only use endpoints you control. Default: https://api.openai.com/v1

TAVILY_API_KEY.description: Tavily API key for real-time macro search.

FUND_SCENE_DIR.description: Directory with optional .md scene templates. Do NOT point to sensitive directories — only .md files in that directory are read.

PUSH_WEBHOOK_URL.description: HTTP POST URL for push notifications (WeCom/Feishu/Slack). Analysis output is sent to this URL if set — only use endpoints you control.

BARK_PUSH_URL.description: Bark notification URL for iOS push alerts.

PUSH_EMAIL.description: Target email for SMTP push. Requires SMTP_HOST/PORT/USER/PASS.

SMTP_HOST.description: SMTP server hostname. Used with PUSH_EMAIL.

QQ_WEBHOOK_URL.description: QQ bot HTTP interface URL (go-cqhttp / Lagrange). Analysis output is sent here if set.

network.description: Calls East Money APIs (no auth) for fund data. Sends prompts and data to the LLM_API_BASE endpoint. Optionally calls Tavily and user-configured push endpoints. No other external network access.

filesystem.description: Reads optional .md scene templates from the user-specified FUND_SCENE_DIR only. Does not access system or credential directories.

notifications.description: Sends analysis summaries ONLY to endpoints explicitly configured by the user. No data sent without user configuration.

security_notes: LLM_MODEL and LLM_API_KEY are required — use a dedicated low-privilege key with quota limits.
LLM_API_BASE: If set to an untrusted or malicious endpoint, your API key and fund data will be sent there. Only use endpoints you control.
FUND_SCENE_DIR: Only .md files in that directory are read. Do NOT point it at system, home, or credential directories.
Push endpoints: Analysis output is transmitted externally — only configure endpoints you trust.
No credential exfiltration: API keys are used only for LLM and push calls, never written to logs.
Review llm.py and fund_api.py before first use to confirm network destinations.
